site.sitedescription: Lake appears to have resulted from impoundment by glacial deposits that run along its sourth shore. Surrounding vegetation: Herb tundra with scattered willows (Salix arctica). Dwarf birch (Betula glandulosa) is widespread in the surrounding lowlands.
